assets.description: 25 object illustrations used consistently on cards, point reveals, and history. CSS crops isolate each illustration.
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production sprite atlas for the browser picture-matching game Spot Clash. Create one square image containing EXACTLY a 5-column by 5-row evenly spaced grid of 25 isolated small collectible object illustrations. All 25 cells have identical dimensions, exact equal spacing, identical plain warm white background #fffdf8, and one centered object per cell. No drawn grid lines or cell borders. All objects completely contained within the central 66 percent of their own cell, with ample empty space around them. Polished whimsical miniature 3D illustration with tactile painted resin, subtle natural texture, richly shaded rounded forms, soft ambient shadows, delicate highlights, vibrant tasteful colors and exceptionally clean recognizable silhouettes. Consistent top-front three-quarter camera, soft light from upper left, no scenery, no letters or numbers. Object layout must follow this order exactly, left to right: row 1: orange fox sitting with white chest and black paws; golden-brown owl with round eyes; red mushroom with cream spots; green maple leaf; pink five-petal flower with yellow center. Row 2: blue butterfly; rose-pink spiral seashell; orange tropical fish; blue whale; red-and-white little sailboat. Row 3: red-and-ivory rocket; ringed purple Saturn planet; golden crescent moon; turquoise five-point star; brass compass with red needle. Row 4: teal vintage camera; antique gold key; copper lantern with warm light; golden royal crown with blue jewels; violet faceted gemstone. Row 5: coral teacup and saucer; red strawberry with green leaves; yellow lemon with green leaf; open rainbow umbrella with curved handle; diamond-shaped orange kite with ribbon tail. Do not repeat or omit any object. Absolutely no text, UI, frames, hands, people, logos, watermark, objects spanning cells, overlapping cells, edge clipping, uneven grid, or gradient across the whole atlas. Opaque warm white background.

assets.description: Two illustrated cards highlighting their shared fox.
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square premium cover art for Spot Clash, a fast picture-matching browser game. Two beautiful thick ivory picture cards lie side by side at slight opposite angles on a soft desaturated midnight-blue tabletop, viewed from above at a slight three-quarter angle. The left card has a subtle teal edge and the right card has a subtle coral edge. Each card shows exactly five charming collectible objects, rendered like polished tactile painted miniature illustrations with soft shadows and rich color. On BOTH cards the central object is the same adorable orange fox with white chest, sitting upright, clearly identical in design and the largest object on that card. Surround the left fox with a red spotted mushroom, a purple ringed planet, a gold key, and a pink shell. Surround the right fox with a teal vintage camera, a yellow lemon, a copper lantern, and a blue butterfly. Only the fox is repeated between the cards. A fine luminous golden circular outline gently highlights each fox, and a few small golden sparkle flecks between the cards convey a match just found. Clear, orderly composition with generous breathing space, warm ivory paper, teal and coral accents, warm natural light, cinematic yet clean premium family board-game styling. Crisp little objects, sophisticated tangible materials, inviting playful visual. No text, letters, numbers, people, hands, dice, playing-card suit symbols, watermarks, or borders.
